evidence.original_label: 面向先进存储的新型 12 英寸晶圆减薄装备 Versatile-GH300
evidence.excerpt:
截至本报告披露日，面向先进存储的新型 12 英寸
晶圆减薄装备 Versatile-GH300 首台装备正式出机可稳定实现亚微米级加工精度，晶圆厚度均匀性
达到行业领先水平，同时具备卓越的单机产出能力

notes: Single stated wafer diameter, not a range: the issuer names Versatile-GH300 only as a 12-inch tool, so relation is eq with no upper bound. Filed at thinning_grinding because the same report's product description (p13) calls GH300 a 高性能减薄机 that 集成了业界领先的超精密磨削技术 and names no CMP or polishing module, unlike the GP300 grind-plus-CMP-plus-clean combined tool, which stays at the thinning parent. A wafer-diameter capability is not a shipment, order, acceptance or installed-base claim. The 亚微米级加工精度 and 晶圆厚度均匀性 claims on this page carry no digit and are not extracted.

evidence.original_label: 首台 8 英寸留环式晶圆减薄机 Versatile-GR200
evidence.excerpt:
首台 8 英寸留环式晶圆减薄机 Versatile-
GR200 成功出机并交付国内集成电路制造领域新兴企业

notes: Single stated wafer diameter, not a range; relation eq. Filed at thinning_grinding because the issuer calls Versatile-GR200 a 晶圆减薄机 of the 留环式 (ring-retained / TAIKO-style) type, a standalone grinder with no polishing or CMP module named. 首台…出机并交付 is a first-unit factory-shipment and delivery milestone; 首台 is an ordinal written without a digit, so no unit count is recorded from it.

evidence.original_label: Versatile-GM300 兼容 8/12 英寸晶圆
evidence.excerpt:
面向封装领域的晶圆减薄贴膜一体机，兼容
8/12 英寸晶圆，采用新型布局，可实现薄型晶
圆背面超精密磨削与应力去除

notes: Filed at the thinning parent, not at a child: Versatile-GM300 is a 减薄贴膜一体机 whose single machine performs both 超精密磨削 (grinding) and 应力去除 (stress removal) plus film lamination. The basket spans thinning_grinding and thinning_stress_relief and must not be allocated across them.

evidence.original_label: 减薄设备研发项目 项目总预算（万元）
evidence.excerpt: 公司正在研发的项目 ... 项目名称 减薄设备研发项目 ｜ 拟达到的研发目标 研发先进制程 IC 后道工序中的晶圆背面超精密减薄设备并建立减薄工艺体系，通过大生产线考核验证。 ｜ 项目总预算（万元） 8,550 ｜ 项目阶段及进展情况 已完成、待验收 ｜ 项目应用 集成电路制造减薄工艺 ｜ 与行业技术水平比较 国际先进水平

As-of date is the prospectus signature date on PDF p3. Printed page 214 = PDF page 215.
